setting: Farming / rural life simulation game with a warm, cozy and light tone with touches of melancholy. Set in Pelican Town and the surrounding Stardew Valley.
tone: Informal: address the player directly and familiarly (use the informal form where the target language has one). Short, natural sentences, like spoken dialogue. No bureaucratic language or word-for-word translation.
style_rules: Proper names of characters and places stay unchanged.
Take care with grammatical gender: the player can be male or female, prefer neutral wording if the text does not use ^ to distinguish.
Keep the length close to the original: dialogue boxes and tooltips have limited space.
Keep expressive punctuation, ellipses and emoticons (e.g. ':)') in dialogue.

characters.Abigail: young, adventurous, loves video games and the mystical
characters.Sebastian: introverted, sarcastic, loves programming and motorcycles
characters.Pierre: shopkeeper, practical and a bit anxious about business
characters.Linus: gentle hermit who lives in a tent
characters.Shane: gruff and depressed, works at Joja
